media.description: Kaper’s entry in the Berliner Adreßbuch, 1932, p. 646.
media.altText: Document image from the Berliner Adreßbuch 1932 showing the Kaper entry.
media.rightsNote: Public domain. The excerpt is two lines of a street directory — a name, the abbreviated occupation, an address and two telephone numbers — and carries none of the personal intellectual creation that German law requires before a work exists. There is accordingly no term to compute and no restoration to consider; the Zentral- und Landesbibliothek Berlin and the Deutsche Digitale Bibliothek supply the Public Domain Mark 1.0 for the 1932 volume.

places.publicNote: Documented Berlin residence: the Berliner Adreßbuch 1932 lists B. Kaper, composer, at Pommersche Straße 3 in Wilmersdorf. A later official planning record identifies the historical corner parcel as Sächsische Straße 48–49 / Pommersche Straße 3–4. Numbers 3–4 are absent from the present official address register, so the marker locates the historical corner parcel approximately rather than a surviving entrance.
